# TorchEEG

> A Python library for EEG signal analysis with PyTorch.

TorchEEG provides datasets, signal transforms, data partitions, neural networks,
and trainers. Match all examples and APIs to the version in use. Unmerged
repository features are not part of a released package.

## Documentation

- [Install](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation.html): Dependencies and package installation.
- [User guide](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/index.html): Data protocols, pretrained models and complete training workflows.
- [EEGMamba](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/eegmamba.html): Complete pretrained encoder, masked reconstruction and EEGMat workflow.
- [TFM tokenizer and encoder](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/tfm.html): Complete paired CHB-MIT checkpoints, reconstruction, EMA training and EEGMat probe.
- [LEAD external backend](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/lead.html): Explicit local author backend, complete checkpoint, geometry persistence and EEGMat probe.
- [Datasets](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.datasets.html): Dataset inputs, metadata and preprocessing.
- [Transforms](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.transforms.html): Signal and label transforms.
- [Partitions](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.model_selection.html): Subject, trial and sample splits.
- [Models](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.models.html): Model parameters and input shapes.
- [Trainers](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/torcheeg.trainers.html): Classification, regression and specialized training.
- [Examples](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/auto_examples/index.html): Runnable workflows and data requirements.
- [Agent guide](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent_guide.html): Using the repository guide and library skill.

- [Leaderboard](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/leaderboard.html): Protocol-specific results, evidence and reproducible examples.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/torcheeg/torcheeg): Source code, tests and releases.
- [Contributor guide](https://github.com/torcheeg/torcheeg/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository layout and checks.
- [Library skill](https://github.com/torcheeg/torcheeg/blob/main/.agents/skills/use-torcheeg/SKILL.md): EEG workflow instructions.

Use subject- or trial-based partitions when the protocol requires isolated groups.
Fit data-dependent preprocessing on training data only. A synthetic smoke test
does not establish EEG accuracy or reproduction of a published benchmark.

- [NeuroRVQ external backend](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/neurorvq.html): Complete separately supplied author model, strict checkpoint loading, electrode metadata and real EEGMat workflow.

- [SleepFM external backends](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/sleepfm.html): Complete upstream, staging and diagnosis models supplied separately, explicit physical metadata, strict checkpoints and standalone workflows.

- [SleepGPT external backend](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/sleepgpt.html): Complete dual-domain author model, both native reconstruction heads, strict checkpoints and real EEGMat transfer workflow.

- [Uni-DMFM external backend](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/unidmfm.html): Complete separately supplied model, all three native pretraining heads, strict complete checkpoints and real EEGMat mean-token transfer workflow.

- [NeuroGPT external backend](https://torcheeg.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/neurogpt.html): Complete Conformer, embedder, causal GPT and reconstruction model supplied separately, native prefix training and real BCI-IV 2a transfer workflow.
